offer_text: The Happiest Hour runs 5-7pm on the Rec Deck: happy-hour food and beverage specials with deck shuffleboard and skyline views of downtown KC. Publicly advertised, no code needed.

business_name: Boulevard Brewing Co. Beer Hall & Tours
offer_text: Their advertised one-hour walking tour of the brewery is $20 and includes a traveling beer, a keepsake hanging can cozy, and two samples of your choice in the Beer Hall. Tours run daily 10:30am-3:30pm.

The publicly listed hour-long guided distillery tour walks you across the production floor and into the rickhouse, then finishes with a guided tasting of their award-winning spirits. Closed-toe shoes required, complimentary parking on the west side.
Weekday happy hour, dine-in only, with specials on local draft beers plus low-and-slow bites like cheesy hushpuppies and a pair of pulled-rib sliders. Advertised roughly 3-6pm.
Happy hour runs Tuesday through Thursday, 3-6pm, in the Bavarian-style Bierhalle and Biergarten, pairing fresh German-style bier brewed on site with pretzels and sausages. No code required.
Weekday happy hour, 4-7pm, at this Country Club Plaza cocktail lounge. Publicly advertised, walk in and settle onto the marble bar.
The advertised beer-and-burger special (Wed-Sat) plates a Classic Burger, Belgian frites, and a beer of your choice for $15 in the cozy wood-lined taproom.

The publicly listed factory tour is $5 (kids 12 and under free) and includes a behind-the-scenes look at the roasting operation, a manual brewing demo, and free coffee samples of their cold brew and nitro. Reservations required.

A publicly advertised combo ticket bundles admission to both the American Jazz Museum and the neighboring Negro Leagues Baseball Museum at a discount, and buying online saves up to $5 off standard admission.
Purchase admission online in advance to save on the combo ticket shared with the American Jazz Museum in the same 18th & Vine building. Publicly advertised discount, no code needed.
